title: Phonon heat transport with squeezing-based symmetry breaking
summary: The controllability of phonon thermal transport is fundamental for numerous technologies, from cooling high-performance chips to managing heat in quantum computing. Despite extensive efforts, on-demand, real-time control of phonon heat flow remains elusive, being fundamentally constrained by the temperature gradient. Here we achieve this long-sought phonon heat transport by introducing a novel mechanism using quantum squeezing in a cavity optomechanical system.
